mapper.select: select t.seq_no seqNo, t.model_code modelCode, t.status status, DATE_FORMAT(t.busi_date,'%Y-%m-%d') busiDate, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') startTime, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') endTime, CASE WHEN status in ('2', '3') THEN round(extract(second from (t.end_time - t.start_time)),2) else 0 END useingTime from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO_DETAIL t where t.seq_no=#{seqNo}
